scope: Independent normative review and static published-schema cross-check of all91 pre-existing verifier-owned CLI vectors; changes only specification_set_identity. This does not claim execution of91 native CLI cases or successful lifecycle admission, runtime authorization or behavioral guard conformance.

normative_distinction.retained_identity: create_agent input grammar is unchanged. Runtime Developer creation must reject retained IDs across projects without mutation; Admin recovery remains allowed. This requires real stateful tests, not a fictitious malformed-input vector.
normative_distinction.registry_preflight: configuration/spec.md:82-89 rejects live/dry-run/file-reload removal or collapse against actual current registry. The CLI validates command syntax without current configuration/storage/auth/network, so existing syntactically valid project-array patches remain valid CLI vectors.
normative_distinction.additional_vectors: No new input field, type, bound or result grammar is introduced by these two fixes, so no new grammar vector is necessary. Existing independently retained native retirement/snapshot and registry-preflight witnesses cover behavior separately.

lifecycle_failure_preserved: Prior failed34 rebuild953cd3… remains failed; this metadata review does not modify receipts, CAS, locks or evidence of that attempt. Official rebuild must independently run its declared gates.
